translation.spanish: Nanak dice, meditando y vibrando en Él, obtendrías el Estado de vida sin miedos y temores.(2-1)

devanagari.text: जाग लेहु रे मना जाग लेहु कहा गाफल सोइआ ॥

english.default: That body, which you were born with, shall not go along with you in the end. ||1||Pause||
